colombia-documentary-fields.OPERATIVE: The Council extended the UN Verification Mission in Colombia until 31 October 2024 [OPERATIVE]. It expressed willingness to work with Colombia's Government on further extension based on agreement between the parties [OPERATIVE].
colombia-documentary-fields.ADDITIONAL: The earlier ELN monitoring authority stems from Resolution 2694. Regarding Government–EMC verification, the legal stage remains a willingness to consider future monitoring, contingent upon Secretary-General confirmation of a ceasefire with appropriate protocols, while taking into account the implementation update on Resolution 2694. [ADDITIONAL]
colombia-documentary-fields.BRAZIL: The presiding representative spoke for Brazil, supporting Colombia's sovereign will and total peace strategy. Brazil urged the Council to respond to Colombia's priorities and hoped for future authorization of EMC verification when sufficiently mature. [BRAZIL]
colombia-documentary-fields.A3: Ghana spoke for the three African members, who supported EMC verification contingent on the Secretary-General's conditions, and pledged to encourage progress on the Ethnic Chapter for Afro-Colombian and Indigenous people [A3].
colombia-documentary-fields.overlap: Limited overlap exists between Brazil and African members on future EMC verification; neither granted actual authority, both awaiting Secretary-General confirmation and maturity. [BRAZIL, A3, ADDITIONAL]
